review_conclusion: No concrete soundness defect found in the reviewed learned ranking, classification, metadata, or benchmark paths.
scope: Independent code review and tests for the learned ranking experiment. This is not a formal proof of the whole pre-existing solver or of every necessary-condition implementation.
classification_contract: Learned search returns an exact replay-verified witness or UNKNOWN; it never returns NG, regardless of model quality, width pruning, or whether exploration appears exhausted.

checks.evidence: The only successful return is core::found, which constructs and replays an exact ReachabilityRecord. Ranking, pruning, candidate constraints and caches never construct Found.

Public retrospective_learned_beam_search converts all internal NotFound outcomes, including boundary misses and exhaustive-looking failures, to Unknown. run_strategy and bench_reverse_search independently reject any learned NotFound as an invariant error.

checks.property: The query requested by the user is replay-verified again
checks.evidence: run_queries passes actions to query::solve_query, which constructs and verifies the exact or explicitly requested transformed goal. The record preserves the absolute side to move and explicit passes.

checks.property: Incorrect model format and unsupported domains fail closed
checks.evidence: Schema, feature version/count, shapes, hidden size and every numerical parameter are checked. Parameters are finite and magnitude-bounded. Public learned search rejects nonstandard starts, invalid goals, mismatched target tables and zero width. Model loading precedes classification-output creation in run_strategy.

checks.property: Inference cannot overflow on the valid feature domain
checks.evidence: 160 features are bounded in [0,1], hidden width is at most 128 and all parameter magnitudes are at most 1e6. The resulting worst-case magnitude is below 2.1e16, far below f64 overflow. A nonfinite score still produces an error at score_priority.

checks.property: Model metadata identifies the instance actually used
checks.evidence: The model is loaded once. SHA-256 hashes its exact JSON bytes. run_strategy writes metadata from that immutable instance; estimate copies the emitted metadata rather than reloading a possibly changed source path. Benchmark variants are keyed by the loaded model hash, and the pipeline checks the used hash against the setup hash.

checks.property: Every benchmark success has a certificate and remains linked to its input
checks.evidence: bench_reverse_search validates start, goal, exact mode and record replay before saving an OK row, and --records-out saves a certificate with the case input index. The independent script checks absolute-board replay and can require certificate counts to match every OK row per input occurrence.

checks.property: Two-stage classification preserves input multiplicities and prior exact results
checks.evidence: bench_reverse_pipeline checks OK/NG/UNKNOWN partitions, certificate/input-index linkage, learned NG absence, and contradictory or lost baseline decisions. The summary distinguishes generated and registered-state budgets and distinguishes estimated fallback times from actual pipeline measurements.

integration_tests.oracle: tests/support/mod.rs; absolute-color array with independent coordinate-based legal moves, captures, explicit pass and terminal rules
integration_tests.certificate_check: Every Found is replayed by the independent array rules and checked against the oracle reachable set and exact goal.

pending_external_checks: None for the reviewed experiment. Publication should preserve the evidence bytes identified by these hashes.

post_review_formatting.scope: Formatting only, as reported by the root agent after the independent review; no search/model semantics changed.

full_repository_tests.verified_by: root agent; complete output retained in scratch

evidence_encoding: Benchmark CSV files retain their original CRLF bytes. Source and found-record CSVs use LF. Verification hashes identify the original bytes, without newline normalization.

post_review_verifier_change.reason: Guard against path replacement between replay and fingerprinting.
post_review_verifier_change.change: Read every input once into immutable bytes and use those same bytes for CSV parsing and SHA-256; reject output paths that alias an input. No search/model/binary changes.
post_review_verifier_change.validation: self-test and all 351 search-validation OK certificates passed; input-index coverage and all original evidence hashes unchanged.

final_capture_checks.capture_review: All benchmark processes finish before evidence checks and publication. Direct runs require per-case OK/certificate multiplicity equality. Pipeline runs validate every stage, bind records to stage input occurrences, and verify a combined certificate file against the original goals. Immutable per-file copies are SHA-256 checked and a completion marker is written last.

discarded_capture.reason: The full OK/certificate coverage check failed. The original capture is retained and excluded from the primary results. Cause of the path replacement remains unresolved.
discarded_capture.resolution: The same frozen models, binary, settings and inputs were rerun into an isolated temporary directory; all 921 OK records passed independent replay and coverage checks before publication. No missing record was fabricated or filled by duplication.

negative_crosschecks.interpretation: These are independent checks relative to reverse search using SAT encodings. UNSAT was reported by the existing SAT solver; a separate DRAT/LRAT proof checker was not run. No performance result or model was changed by these post-benchmark correctness checks.
